observations.behavior: Documentation entry added: a new rule recommending CardGroup for clickable row lists.
observations.code_quote: - A list of clickable rows (tickets, programs, recent items) → `CardGroup` of `Card size="sm"`, each holding one full-width `<button>` or `<a>`. Item has no clickable variant. `Item tone` is for callouts only, such as a warning or an incident notice
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a design-system rule; no implementation or shared component change is supplied.

observations.behavior: Documentation entry added: a new rule recommending inline Button for inline links.
observations.code_quote: - An inline link inside a sentence uses the same text size as the sentence: `<Button variant="link" size="inline">`. The other `Button` sizes set a control height and their own font size, so they never match the text around them. Don't patch one with `h-auto p-0`
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a design-system rule; no implementation or shared component change is supplied.

observations.code_quote: | Button       | default, primary, secondary, outline, destructive, destructive-outline, link, link-muted | default, xs, sm, lg, icon, icon-xs, icon-sm, icon-lg, row, inline | `loading` overlays a centered spinner and disables the button (width stays stable). `row` is the full-width, regular-weight list row that menu, combobox and autocomplete items render. `inline` is a link inside a sentence: no height or padding, and it inherits the sentence's font size and line height. `elevated` adds heavy CTA chrome — see Elevated button. |
